Ensures both systems emit audit logs

GOV-F-004-S147.title: Audit Log Query & Retrieval API
GOV-F-004-S147.description: Implement secure internal API for querying audit logs by trace_id, actor, event_type, and time range. Enforce read-only access, pagination limits, and redaction of sensitive payload fields where required.
GOV-F-004-S147.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (read patterns, limits, auth); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S148.title: Hash Chain Integrity Validator
GOV-F-004-S148.description: Implement background or on-demand validator that traverses audit logs and verifies hash chain integrity (previous_hash linkage). Flag and log any inconsistencies as critical audit violations.

GOV-F-004-S149.title: Cross-System Integration (GPT + Claude Logging)
GOV-F-004-S149.description: Integrate audit logging SDK into GPT (brain_runner, gpt_reader) and Claude (FastAPI tool_router, domain services) execution paths to ensure all critical operations emit audit events.
GOV-F-004-S149.evidence: Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (GPT orchestration); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (GPT read service); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (Claude execution path); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S150.title: Audit Logging Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
GOV-F-004-S150.description: Develop comprehensive tests covering schema validation, append-only enforcement, hash chain integrity, and cross-system logging behavior. Include negative tests for mutation attempts and tampering scenarios.
